texts.title: Texts to read aloud
texts.description: One audio file per text. Plain text or Markdown (headings, bold, links and lists are cleaned up before reading). Up to 200,000 characters per text.
prefill: Welcome to our channel! Today we test three website speed tools and show you which one is worth your time.

items.title: Or: items with id, voice and speed (JSON)
items.description: For batch jobs from code, a spreadsheet or n8n/Make/Zapier: [{"id": "intro", "text": "...", "voice": "bm_george", "speed": 1.1}]. id becomes the file name; voice and speed are optional and override the defaults below.

textFileUrls.title: Or: links to .txt / .md files
textFileUrls.description: Direct links to plain text or Markdown files (max 2 MB each), e.g. a chapter for an audiobook. Web pages are not read: convert them to text first.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: 41 voices in 7 languages. The first letter sets the language: a = US English, b = UK English, e = Spanish, f = French, h = Hindi, i = Italian, p = Brazilian Portuguese.

voiceBlend.title: Voice blend (optional)
voiceBlend.description: Mix voices of the same language into a unique custom voice, e.g. af_heart:0.6, af_bella:0.4. Leave empty to use the voice above.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Speaking rate (1.0 = natural). Items can set any value from 0.5 to 2.0.

format.title: Audio format
enumTitles: Opus in OGG (smallest, WhatsApp/Telegram voice notes)
format.description: MP3 works everywhere. Opus is the smallest; M4A suits Apple devices; WAV and FLAC are lossless for editing.

bitrate.title: Bitrate (kbps)
bitrate.description: For MP3, Opus and M4A. 64 is fine for speech in Opus; 128 for MP3.

subtitles.title: Subtitles
subtitles.description: Sentence-level subtitle files with exact timings (we time every sentence as it is generated). Free.

mergeIntoOneFile.title: Also merge all texts into one file
mergeIntoOneFile.description: Adds all-texts.<format> (and merged subtitles) to the key-value store, with 1 s between texts. Handy for audiobooks and playlists. Free.

stripMarkdown.title: Clean up Markdown
stripMarkdown.description: Removes Markdown/HTML symbols, code blocks and link URLs so they are not read aloud. Turn off for plain text that uses * or # on purpose.

sentencePauseMs.title: Pause between sentences (ms)
sentencePauseMs.description: Extra silence between sentences. 250 ms sounds natural; raise it for slow, calm narration.

paragraphPauseMs.title: Pause between paragraphs (ms)
paragraphPauseMs.description: Extra silence between paragraphs (blank lines) and after headings.

includeSentenceTimings.title: Include sentence timings in the dataset
includeSentenceTimings.description: Adds a sentences array (start, end, text) to every result, e.g. for karaoke-style captions or video editors.
